selected_evidence.requirement: Transit and private link addressing configured and reachable
selected_evidence.summary: IP addresses assigned on both transit links and both private links; ping confirms L2/L3 reachability node1<->node2 on both transit subnets and node1<->node3, node2<->node4

selected_evidence.requirement: Dynamic redundant routing (OSPF) established over both transit paths with ECMP
selected_evidence.summary: OSPF configured on VyOS (native FRR) and OPNsense (installed os-frr, edited Quagga model, regenerated frr.conf); vtysh shows Full adjacency on both transit links from both routers, with ECMP route to the far private subnet installed via both next-hops

selected_evidence.requirement: Private hosts (node3, node4) reach each other end-to-end
selected_evidence.summary: Direct ping from node3 (10.10.10.10) to node4 (10.10.20.10) and vice versa succeeds with 0% loss

selected_evidence.requirement: Connectivity continues when transit-A is taken out of service, and recovers on restoration (the required failover transition)
selected_evidence.summary: Continuous ping from node3 to node4 kept running while VyOS eth1 (transit-A) was disabled and later re-enabled; log analysis shows zero gaps across all 117 sequence numbers, OSPF neighbor table shows adjacency dropped to transit-B only then both links Full again after restoration

selected_evidence.requirement: Connectivity continues when transit-B is taken out of service, and recovers on restoration (second independent failover transition, post rp_filter fix)
selected_evidence.summary: Continuous ping kept running while OPNsense vtnet2 (transit-B) was taken down and restored; only 1 packet lost out of 147, OSPF route reconverged to transit-A alone during the outage and back to dual-path Full adjacency afterward

selected_evidence.requirement: Root-caused and fixed rp_filter dropping ECMP-routed replies (correctness fix, not just workaround)
selected_evidence.summary: tcpdump on node2 and node4 proved ICMP echo requests arrived at node4 but no reply was generated; disabling rp_filter on node3/node4 resolved it, confirmed by successful ping immediately after the sysctl change
